notes: Unjess v2.9.9 - Interactive Chat Session Renaming, Conversation Rename REST API, Silent Windows Background Daemon Execution (-H=windowsgui), GGUF & Windows Path Local Provider Routing.

changelog.title: Interactive Chat Session Renaming & Conversation Title REST API
changes: Interactive Chat Session Renaming: Added inline rename button (pencil icon) and double-click to rename conversations across both project workspace trees and quick chats
Header Session Renaming: Clickable middle header session title with dedicated rename button for instant title updates
Conversation Rename REST API: Added POST and PATCH /api/harness/conversations/{id}/rename with atomic title persistence in ~/.unjess/state.json

changelog.title: Silent Windows Daemon Execution (-H=windowsgui) & GGUF Local Provider Routing
changes: Silent Windows Daemon Execution: Built unjessd.exe with -H=windowsgui linker flag (PE32+ GUI subsystem) to eliminate terminal/cmd popups

GGUF & Windows Path Provider Routing: Fixed provider detection so Windows absolute file paths (e.g. E:\models\...) and .gguf files route cleanly to llama.cpp / LM Studio rather than failing with Ollama 'invalid model name' error
OpenAI /v1 Base URL Normalization: Automatically ensures llama.cpp and LM Studio endpoints call /v1/chat/completions even if user specifies root port URL
Active Provider Synchronization: Synchronizes active provider in settings and chat execution payload when selecting models from local providers

changelog.title: Dynamic Model Discovery for llama.cpp & LM Studio, Test & Fetch Controls
changes: Automated llama.cpp Model Discovery: Directly queries /v1/models on llama-server to populate active GGUF models into UI dropdowns
LM Studio Discovery: Directly queries /v1/models on LM Studio server with automatic optgroup categorization
Instant Settings Probing: Added dedicated 'Fetch' model discovery controls for llama.cpp and LM Studio endpoints
Dynamic Runtime Versioning: Complete unification of runtime versioning across daemon, CLI, desktop shell, and system prompts

changelog.title: Dynamic Runtime Versioning & Terminal-Bench 4.0 Near-Miss Hardening
changes: Dynamic Runtime Versioning: Unified canonical version across Go daemon, CLI, settings API, and agent self-knowledge prompts
Terminal-Bench 4.0 Near-Miss Hardening: Pre-exit verifier guard and automated residual convergence checks
Headless Execution Reliability: Streamlined subprocess monitoring and graceful container cleanup

changelog.title: Execution-Surface Verification Doctrine, Symbolic Adversarial Testing & Domain Rule Validation
changes: Execution-Surface Verification Doctrine: Enforces active independent test execution on changed paths with zero tolerance for partial passes ('3 of 4 passed' is treated as failure until 100% clean)

Symbolic & Mathematical Grader Hardening: Added explicit handling for symbolic edge cases including set unions, integration constants (+ C), piecewise expressions, units stripping, boxed LaTeX extraction, and tuple structures
Domain Rule & Classification Alignment: Enforces strict evaluation of rule ordering, exclusion semantics in mutual exclusion pairs, strict vs non-strict inequalities, and ground truth validation
Continuous Self-Correction Loop: Mandates immediate iterative root-cause fixes before concluding any execution turn

changelog.title: Harness Hardening: Negative File Constraints, Autonomous Continuation Invariants & Catalog Optimization
changes: Negative File Constraints & Protected Paths: Automatically parses negative constraints from task prompts ('Do not modify /app/...') and locks write_file, edit_file, and mutating bash commands with PermissionDenied

Autonomous Continuation Invariant: Detects intermediate narration commentary ('I will now test...', 'Let me inspect...') or empty reasoning turns, injecting immediate system guidance to keep execution active instead of exiting prematurely
Subagent Model Catalog Optimization: Only injects the full 25-model subagent catalog when tasks explicitly reference parallel workers, delegation, or models, slashing system prompt token bloat
Active Tool Surface Unification: Dynamic tool definition filtering respecting per-turn disabled tool sets and unified MCP tool registration

changelog.title: Antigravity 7-Point Harness Engine: Smart Micro-Compaction, 30KB Output Windowing & AST Tool Alignment
changes: Smart Micro-Compaction & Token Conservation: Compacts historical assistant turns and superseded file-read tool outputs into dense single-line references once context exceeds 140,000 characters, maximizing KV-cache reuse while avoiding context window overflow

Output Windowing & Truncation Caching: Caches terminal tool outputs >30,000 bytes or 300 lines to disk with head, error-context, and tail slicing, preventing context exhaustion from verbose build and test outputs
12-Tool Core Routing & Adaptive Tool Search: Replaced monolithic tool schemas with 12 foundational tools and dynamic runtime tool search, saving thousands of tokens per prompt
Hardened Smart File Editing: Advanced multi-pass fuzzy matching with auto-strip of markdown/line numbers and relative indentation preservation for zero-failure file edits
Tool Call Aliasing & Auto-Repair: Automatic normalization of hallucinated tool names and fuzzy JSON parameter repair for unformatted model outputs
Autonomous Prompt Optimization & Zero Double-Thinking: Ultra-lean system instructions preventing duplicate <think> blocks on reasoning-capable models and automatic scratch file cleanup

changelog.title: Antigravity Unified Activity Dropdown, Crisp Status Dots & 100% Lag-Free Typing
changes: Antigravity Unified Activity Dropdown: Consolidated all planning steps, tool executions, and reasoning into a single clean dropdown timeline with human-readable action verbs, duration badges, and inline expandable details
100% Lag-Free Typing: Eliminated UI input lag and DOM thrashing in chat input while the agent is executing and streaming via targeted in-place timestamp and token updates
Crisp Solid Status Dots: Fixed dot clipping and missing completed states; running items show non-clipped solid dot with smooth ripple, completed items show solid emerald dots

changelog.title: Strict Hidden-by-Default Activity Traces & Execution Details
changes: Hidden-by-Default Activity Traces: Enforced strict collapsed-by-default behavior across Agent Activity trace, execution steps, tool call details, and reasoning tokens both during live streaming and upon completion
Zero Visual Clutter: Live streaming displays only clean animated status row and streamed markdown text unless details are explicitly expanded by the user
Persistent User Toggle State: Details only expand when user explicitly clicks [Show details], preserving state seamlessly across streaming updates

changelog.title: Changes & Code Diffs Inspector Panel & Clean Chat Stream
changes: Code Changes & Diffs Inspector: Transformed right inspector sidebar into dedicated file diffs view with addition/deletion stats (+A -D), unified diffs, and individual hunk reversion
Eliminated Duplicate Thinking: Fixed UI logic so reasoning tokens render strictly once in Model Thinking & Reasoning rather than duplicating in planning step details
Ultra-Clean Chat Feed: Removed code diffs from the chat message feed completely, showing only assistant answers and collapsed Execution Trace pills with interactive Diff buttons

changelog.title: MCP Large Payload & Binary Attachment Interceptor
changes: Automatic Binary Extraction: Automatically intercepts large Base64 / binary file payloads (PDFs, images, archives) returned by email, fetch, or file MCP tools and extracts them directly to workspace downloads/
Context Window Protection: Replaces multi-megabyte Base64 payload blobs with clean disk file pointers, preventing context truncation and token exhaustion
Full Binary Parity: Instant support for PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, ZIP, DOCX, and raw binaries with clean metadata (filePath, status, size_bytes)

changelog.title: Persistent Task Scheduler, CLI Session Isolation, Quoting Fixes & Tooling Upgrades
changes: Persistent Task Scheduler: Native cron, wall-clock, and interval scheduler engine running persistently in background daemon with REST API, CLI /schedule command, and Desktop GUI management tab
CLI Session Isolation: Enforced clean, dedicated conversation sessions for CLI launches, eliminating cross-GUI context leakage
Windows Execution Robustness: Git Bash auto-routing and PowerShell Base64 -EncodedCommand execution preventing quote stripping on Windows
Large File Streaming: Added start_line and end_line range slicing with streaming reader in read_file primitive for massive files
Plan Mode Scratchpad Allowance: Permitted write_file in scratch/ and .tmp/ directories during Plan Mode for non-destructive diagnostic exploration
CLI Trace Compaction: Support for collapsible single-line tool execution traces with /trace and Ctrl+O toggles

changelog.title: Hotfix: Clean JavaScript Execution, Lucide Icon Restoration & UI Reactivity
changes: JavaScript Engine Fix: Eliminated trailing syntax error in desktop interface ensuring 100% clean evaluation across all scripts
Lucide Icon Restoration: Restored full vector icon rendering across sidebar tabs, model selector, and settings views
Immediate Auto-Update Detection: Bumped release version so existing installations immediately detect update and refresh without manual reinstall

changelog.title: Header Minimalism, Window Min-Size Reduction & Draggable Sidepanels
changes: Header Minimalism: Stripped redundant badges and engine pills for a clean, focused navigation bar
Reduced Window Min-Size: Lowered desktop minimum window bounds to 480x400 for flexible screen tiling
Draggable Resizable Sidepanels: Added interactive split dividers for sidebar and context inspector with width persistence
Synchronized Go & Rust Architecture: Full parity across daemon, desktop runner, and distribution binaries

changelog.title: Collapsible Execution Trace, Noir Minimal UI & File Drag-and-Drop Fix
changes: Collapsible Execution Trace: Pure monochrome noir activity drawer grouping tool calls, diffs, thinking streams, and file touches into an expandable row, collapsed by default for clean response reading
Zero-Emoji Technical Minimalism: Eliminated all decorative emojis from activity summaries, headers, and UI status bars in favor of refined Lucide vector icons
Image & Screenshot Drag-and-Drop Fix: Added runasoriginaluser to installer preventing Windows UIPI elevation drop-blocks and broadened image extension detection (.png, .jpg, .webp, .gif)
Seamless In-App Update: Streamlined binary staging and auto-restart across Unjess Desktop and background daemon

changelog.title: Autonomous Loop Continuation Invariant, Read-Only Spec Fences, Pre-Exit Test Protocol & UI Toast Deduplication
changes: Autonomous Continuation Invariant: Intercepts intermediate narration or planned intent emitted without tool calls, injecting synthetic continuation nudges to prevent premature loop breaks and GUI stalls

Read-Only & Spec File Fences: Automatically parses negative constraints from task prompts (e.g., 'Do not modify /app/run_pretrain.sh') and enforces hard PermissionDenied blocks across write_file, edit_file, and destructive shell commands
Pre-Exit Test Verification Protocol: Actively verifies that executed regression and unit tests passed without errors before allowing task completion, requiring the model to resolve failures first
UI Toast Deduplication & Stacking Guard: Prevents duplicate notification pills from stacking indefinitely on repeated update checks and caps active notifications

changelog.title: Harness Evolution: Head/Tail Truncation, Dynamic Timeouts & Async Tasks, Adversarial Self-Audit & GUI Virtualization
changes: Error-Aware Context & Log Truncation: Scans omitted middle lines for test failures, panics, and tracebacks (FAILED, AssertionError, Traceback, SyntaxError) to pin the exact failure context in terminal output
Claude Code Parity Tool Usage Policy: Enforces dedicated file tools (read_file, edit_file) over shell primitives and mandates surgical diff string replacement
Dynamic Step Budget Countdown: Injects proactive budget alerts at <=5 steps remaining prompting the model to halt exploration, finalize solutions, and cleanup
Pre-Exit Syntax Sanity Verification: Automated AST and compiler sanity check intercepts exit if modified files contain severe syntax errors, requiring immediate self-healing
Workspace Cleanliness & Artifact Cleanup Invariant: Mandates removal of temporary test scripts, scratch files, and intermediate debug logs before task completion
Dynamic Timeouts & Asynchronous Task Manager: run_command accepts custom timeout_seconds (up to 1800s); added start_task, poll_task, cancel_task and is_background: true execution
Head & Tail Context Truncation: stdout/stderr exceeding 80 lines or 8KB is cached to disk in .unjess/logs/ and injected as 25-head / 35-tail lines with on-demand pointers
Adversarial Self-Verification Invariant: Core system prompt enforces autonomous verification scripts and edge-case testing before completion
Multi-directory Skills Package Architecture: GitHub skills installation clones full directory trees with executable permissions preserved
GUI Typing Lag Fix: Implemented DOM message virtualization windowing, CSS content-visibility: auto, and requestAnimationFrame debouncing
Windows Defender False Positive Compliance: Clean Go linker flags (-trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -buildid="), embedded winres metadata, and zero third-party packers

changelog.title: High-Capacity Subagents (300 Turns), Per-Worker Max Turns & Fail-Safe Report Synthesis
changes: Increased default subagent maximum turn limit from 50 to 300 turns to support complex long-running autonomous building and refactoring workflows
Added per-worker max_turns parameter in invoke_subagent allowing parent agents to assign custom iteration budgets per subagent
Added fail-safe report synthesis in executeSubagentLoop: subagents that reach their turn limit or complete without text now return structured activity summaries instead of empty reports

changelog.title: Token Budget & Context Intelligence (/budget, /context), Browser-Use CDP Engine & Auto Error Learning
changes: Added /budget (/price) and /context slash commands and interactive dashboards showing session, day, week, month, and year token & USD telemetry plus per-layer context window usage
Upgraded Browser tab with dual-mode Web Proxy + Browser-Use CDP Engine (numbered interactive DOM element overlays, click/type/scroll/navigate actions)
Added Harness2-inspired Auto Error Learning & Tool Self-Correction engine persisting verified tool fixes across sessions
Streamlined Right Inspector and Project Explorer UI with clean green active workspace folder indicator and 1M/262K cloud model context window limits

changelog.title: Reasoning Effort Levels (Auto/Low/Med/High/Max), October 2026 Models & Live Thinking Stream
changes: Added Reasoning Effort Selector (Auto, Low, Med, High, Max, Off) directly inside the Model Select dropdowns

Added native API effort levels across Anthropic (Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, Haiku 5.5), Google Gemini (Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini 3.8 Flash), QwenCloud/DashScope (Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1, GLM 5.3), Moonshot (Kimi K3, K2.7 Code), and OpenAI (GPT-5, o3, o4-mini)
Fixed live Model Thinking & Reasoning stream auto-expansion during active turns across Gemini, Claude 5.5, Qwen, and Kimi
Added Caveman & Ponytail prompt dock toggles and fixed Moonshot (.ai/.cn) and Qwen DashScope (Intl/CN/Coding) multi-region endpoint auto-fallback

changelog.title: Frontier v2.1.0 - AST Engine, Shadow Worktrees, Self-Healing, Visual QA & Red/White Security Duel
changes: Added AST Code Intelligence Engine with ast_outline, ast_find_callers, ast_edit_symbol, and ast_rename_symbol
Added Automatic Linter & Compiler Self-Healing Feedback Loop verifying files after write_file and edit_file
Added Shadow Git Worktrees & Speculative Multi-Branch Execution (speculative_execute) with Hunk-Level Diff Revert in UI
Added Red Team vs. White Team Autonomous Pentesting & Auto-Remediation Duel (sec_attack_surface, sec_taint_scan, sec_smart_fuzz, sec_supply_chain_audit, run_security_duel)

Added Self-Evolving Tool Synthesis (synthesize_tool), Multimodal Visual QA Loop (visual_qa_screenshot), Time-Travel Crash Inspector (debug_trace), Git Archeology (git_archeology), and Ghost-Coder Watchdog

changelog.title: Seamless Windows Process Restart & Robust Update Pipeline
changes: Added robust Windows detached process restart engine launching new Unjess.exe and cleanly closing old instances
Added target executable resolution updating both desktop shell (Unjess.exe) and background daemon (unjessd.exe)
Added frontend active health polling with automatic window reload when new version comes online
Fixed update button state handling with reliable try/finally guards preventing indefinite spinning

changelog.title: Interactive Slash Commands & Instant MCP Awareness
changes: Added interactive "/" Slash Commands Palette in prompt box with floating, searchable menu and arrow/tab navigation (/compact, /goal, /plan, /subagent, /skill, /web, /mcp, /memory, /clear, /help)
Added native mcp_status tool for main agent and subagents to inspect all connected MCP servers and available tools in a single call
Auto-injected <connected_mcp_servers> directly into system prompt for instantaneous 0-second MCP tool awareness

changelog.title: Mobile Viewport & Prompt Dock Fix
changes: Added dynamic mobile viewport height tracking (100dvh + window.visualViewport.height) adapting automatically to mobile browser URL and toolbar heights
Added min-h-0 across the flex chain and pinned #chat-input-dock with flex-shrink-0 above mobile browser toolbars and keyboard
Added automatic viewport height synchronization on resize and scroll events

changelog.title: Cross-Session Memory, Live Web Tools & Go/Rust Architecture
changes: Added Cross-Session Persistent Memory Engine (memory.go) storing memories in ~/.unjess/memory/memories.json across 5 categories (preference, project, fact, decision, architecture)
Added 3 native memory tools for agents and subagents: memory_save, memory_recall, and memory_delete
Added Automatic Cross-Session Context Injection (agent.go) with <cross_session_memory> and <recent_sessions_context>
Added Native Live Internet Tools (tools.go): web_search via DuckDuckGo and read_url with clean Markdown/text conversion
Replaced 50 MB embedded Python runtime with native 8.6 MB Go backend daemon (unjessd) and 1.3 MB Rust desktop shell
Added Antigravity-style Parallel Subagent Spawning (invoke_subagent) with concurrent Go worker goroutines
Built Split-Screen Live Subagent Transcript Inspector with real-time thinking, file diffs, and direct subagent messaging
Added Built-in Auto-Updater & Release Changelog Engine connected to unjess.si
Standardized Windows command execution on hidden PowerShell and added dynamic Ollama context sizing (num_ctx >= 16384)

changelog.title: Mashina Collab Native MCP & Dynamic Model Discovery
changes: Added native HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 + SSE MCP transport with built-in Mashina Collab (mashina.si/api/collab/mcp) integration
Dynamic model discovery across local Ollama and all 12 configured cloud API key providers
Restored custom theme accent color engine with dynamic CSS variables

changelog.title: Monochrome Carbon Aesthetic, Multimodal Attachments & Native Folder Picker
changes: Redesigned interface in high-contrast monochrome carbon palette
Added Ctrl+V clipboard image paste, drag-and-drop file attachments, and automatic 4K image optimization
Added Quick Chat auto-isolated workspaces and native Windows Folder Picker dialog

changelog.title: Skills Library, REA Preinstalled Skill & MCP Control Center
changes: Preinstalled Reverse Engineer Anything (morluto/rea) skill and 1-click MCP server presets
Added GitHub Skill Repository installer and 6-tab Settings Control Center
